Container.Name: Sonos_Panel
Container.Overview:
Sonos touchscreen panel - a Node/Express app that controls Sonos speakers via a browser-based touch UI.
This container requires a fixed IP address on a custom Docker network (br0) for Sonos SSDP discovery to work correctly. Standard bridge or host networking will not reliably discover speakers.
Change Docker custom network type to ipvlan (highly recommended for Sonos)
Setup instructions: 1. In Unraid, go to Settings -> Docker -> Network Types, and make sure br0 is set to ipvlan mode. 2. When adding this container, set Network Type to br0. 3. Set the Fixed IP Address field to a free IP on your LAN (must not conflict with your router's DHCP range or any other device). 4. Apply, then access the panel at http://<the-ip-you-chose>/ - no port number needed.
Optional: map the Music Path field at a folder of music files on this server to enable the built-in Local Music Library (streams your files straight to the speakers -- no Sonos 65,000-song index limit).

Config.Name: AppData Config Path
Config.Description: Persistent config storage

Config.Name: Music Path
Config.Description: Optional. Folder on this server containing your music files (e.g. /mnt/user/Media/Music). Enables the Local Music Library -- the panel streams these files straight to the speakers, with no Sonos 65,000-song index limit. Read-only: the panel never modifies your files. Music on a different machine? Mount it on the Unraid HOST first (Unassigned Devices plugin -> /mnt/remotes/...) and point this field there -- do not enter a \\server\share path, Windows-style UNC paths do not work inside the container.

Config.Name: Public Base URL
Config.Description: Optional. The URL the SPEAKERS use to fetch music from the panel, e.g. http://10.1.10.25 -- only used by the Local Music Library. Leave blank to auto-detect, which works correctly on br0/ipvlan (this template's setup) and host networking. Only set this if speakers fail to play local files.

Config.Name: Rescan Schedule
Config.Description: Optional, Local Music Library only. When to automatically rescan the music folder: daily@HH:MM (e.g. daily@03:30) or weekly@DAY@HH:MM (e.g. weekly@sun@04:00, days mon-sun). Times use the TZ setting below. Leave blank for no scheduled rescans -- a rescan ALWAYS runs at container start regardless, and unchanged files are skipped, so startup scans are quick once the library is indexed.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for the Rescan Schedule times (IANA name, e.g. America/Denver, America/New_York, Europe/London). Only matters if Rescan Schedule is set.

Config.Name: Application Port
Config.Description: Internal port the app listens on. Leave at 80 to match the WebUI link, which assumes no port number is needed.

Config.Name: Sonos System (s1 or s2)
Config.Description: Which Sonos generation this container controls: s2 (current, default) or s1 (legacy 11.x systems). One container = one generation -- S1 and S2 are separate households that cannot mix. To control both, install this container twice with different fixed IPs and appdata paths, one per system. Also adjusts the Local Music Library's codec limits (S1 caps lossless at 16-bit; S2 allows 24-bit FLAC/ALAC).

Config.Name: Passcode
Config.Description: Optional. A 4-digit code that locks down structural changes on the panel: deleting or renaming playlists, editing account names, adding tracks to playlists, and any group add/edit/apply. Playback and queue control stay open. After a correct entry the panel stays unlocked while in use; 60 seconds without any touch locks it again. Leave blank to disable the lock entirely.

Config.Name: Screensaver Timeout (seconds)
Config.Description: Seconds of no touch/click before the screensaver activates.

Config.Name: Tab 2 Title
Config.Description: Optional second tab. Name shown on the tab -- leave everything in this group blank to not show a second tab.

Config.Name: Tab 2 Color
Config.Description: Optional second tab. Hex color for this tab's underline -- falls back to the app's default accent color if left blank.

Config.Name: Tab 2 Icon
Config.Description: Optional second tab. Icon shown at the start of the tab -- an emoji (e.g. house) or a full image URL both work. Leave blank for no icon.

Config.Name: Tab 2 URL
Config.Description: Optional second tab. Full URL of the site/dashboard to embed (e.g. a Hubitat or Home Assistant dashboard). This tab only appears if this is set.

Config.Description: Optional third tab. Name shown on the tab.
